unit_factors.description: The conversion factors for the stage's units, for each axis. Give one value if it is the same for all axes. Extra values are ignored and lacking values are set to last provided value.

unit_factor.description: Conversion factor for the stage's units. A single value applied to all axes (scalar alias of 'unit_factors').

guardrail_um.title: Max move distance
guardrail_um.description: Maximum allowed distance for a single move, per axis, in micrometers. Any move longer than this is blocked when 'guardrail_enabled' is true.

guardrail_enabled.title: Enable max move distance
guardrail_enabled.description: Enable the 'Max move distance' guardrail (block any single move longer than 'guardrail_um').

soft_limits_enabled.title: Stage area limit
soft_limits_enabled.description: Confine every move to a rectangular area ('Stage area limit'). Moves whose target is outside the area are blocked. The area can be resized in the viewer.

soft_limits_min.title: Stage area limit lower bounds
soft_limits_min.description: Lower bounds of the stage area limit, per axis, in micrometers.

soft_limits_max.title: Stage area limit upper bounds
soft_limits_max.description: Upper bounds of the stage area limit, per axis, in micrometers.

backlashes_um.description: Backlash compensation for each axis, in micrometers.

shear.description: Shear correction factors applied to the X and Y axes.

type.description: A Physik Instrumente, Daisy-chain Mercury Servo Controller, or GCS-compatible.

num_axis.description: Number of axes of the dummy stage.

type.description: A Stage responding to a Rest API.
